title: Kth Distinct String in an Array
summary: Define a distinct string as one appearing exactly once in an array.
statement: Define a distinct string as one appearing exactly once in an array. Given an array of strings and an integer k, identify the kth distinct string in the array. If fewer than k distinct strings exist, return an empty string.
constraints: arr has 1 through 1000 strings and k is positive.
A distinct string appears exactly once in the full array.
Return the kth distinct string in original order, or empty string if fewer exist.
hints: Distinctness depends on the entire array, but kth order depends on the original traversal.
Count all strings first, then scan again and decrement k only at frequency one.
On count[value]==1, k-=1 and return when k reaches zero; otherwise return empty.
The scan filters exactly the distinct strings without reordering them, making its kth accepted item the required result.
editorial: The scan filters exactly the distinct strings without reordering them, making its kth accepted item the required result.

Every string appears once and aaa is first.
